name: Prior-Day Level Acceptance Retest
hypothesis: After an M15 close beyond the prior broker-day high/low, the first retest that holds the level signals acceptance outside prior value and extension.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop beyond the retest extreme plus 0.3 M15 ATR; 2.5R objective; exit by min(8h, next broker gap); 06-19 UTC except crypto.
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
